definitions.explanation: So outstanding that there is no equal in the world. A literary term most commonly used to describe beauty.

examples.japanese: {絶世|ぜっせい}の{美女|びじょ}と{呼|よ}ばれた。
examples.english: She was called a peerless beauty.

examples.japanese: クレオパトラは{絶世|ぜっせい}の{美女|びじょ}として{知|し}られている。
examples.english: Cleopatra is known as a peerless beauty.

examples.japanese: {歴史|れきし}に{名|な}を{残|のこ}す{絶世|ぜっせい}の{美女|びじょ}たちの{物語|ものがたり}を{集|あつ}めた{本|ほん}を{読|よ}んでいる。
examples.english: I'm reading a book that collects stories of peerless beauties who left their names in history.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost exclusively used in the fixed phrase {絶世|ぜっせい}の{美女|びじょ} (peerless beauty). A literary and somewhat dramatic expression. Can also appear as {絶世|ぜっせい}の{美人|びじん}. Rarely used with other nouns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絶世|ぜっせい}の{美女|びじょ} (peerless beauty — woman)
- {絶世|ぜっせい}の{美人|びじん} (peerless beauty — person)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {比類|ひるい}なき: unparalleled — literary, broader usage
- {無双|むそう}: peerless, unmatched — used for strength or skill
